notes.title: Fox Plush now available and update on the game
notes.notes:
Hi Fox Riders, 

It's out! The Three Tailed Fox Plush from Epistory is now available on [url=https://shop.makeship.com/3ucFrod]Makeship[/url]. We now have 21 days to reach the minimum funding goal of 200 pre-orders to launch the production. The Epistory plush is a limited edition so it won't be possible to find it after the campaign. Don't miss it out! Once the product is ready, we ship it directly to you.

BONUS: With every plush purchase you will receive a digital copy of Epistory!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10168702/0ba7022f9d4521c17ce3124d7bbeec03b849127d.png[/img]

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/xOzLFs0wHIg4G8L6Wc/giphy.gif[/img]

[h2]Game update[/h2]
On a side note, we compiled all the bugs reports since our last update and worked on an update to fix them. 

[h3]Fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Sfx (ambiance) still audible in fire dungeon even when all sound disabled
[*] Arena score not displayed in "me" tab
[*] "Tree Name" code display above tree barks instead of word
[*] Some diacritics not typeable on Linux & MacOS
[*] English words in Russian dictionary
[*] Wrong keyboard in the UI
[*] "Easiest" is now easier
[*] Tweaked some smaller issues
[/list] 

This, we hope, will be the last update on our beloved Epistory. 

We are very grateful to all the players who showed so much love for the game since its release in March 2016. ːepipartyː

Thank you very much. 

-VirginRedemption

notes.title: Patch: Bug fixes and improvements
notes.notes:
Hi Fox Riders, 

I am happy to see that our community is growing with more and more Fox Riders everyday. Thank you so much for joining us and for the good reviews left on Steam. 

Now that we entered the post-production of our current game in developing Nanotale, we decided to spend time on the few bugs remaining in Epistory. 

[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Sfx (ambiance sound) still audible in fire dungeon even when all sounds are disabled
[*] Arena score is not displayed in "me" tab
[*] Suspicious scores removed from the leaderboard
[*] "Tree Name" code is displayed above tree barks instead of word
[*] "There is no word on torches in first dungeon" ([url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/398850/discussions/3/1643169632564549661/]read thread here[/url])
[*] English words in Russian dictionary
[*] Wrong keyboard in the UI
[*] Tweaked some other smaller issues 
[/list]

[h3]Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] "Very easy" is now easier
[/list]

Please don't hesitate to let us know if your encounter any more issues.

Cheers,
-VirginRedemption

notes.title: Nanotale Update: The Sunken Caves in 3D
notes.notes:
Hi Fox Riders, 

Last week we started some modeling for our second biome :epiparty: And because it's called the Sunken Caves it will, of course, start with rocks! 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10168702/6e17736c98b8366fc09cb2eb6f5ae83a9c83789a.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10168702/25bccc2a703077226562ea0d72851310558f05ef.png[/img]

There are multiple entrances to the Sunken Caves but the main one is located North of the Ancestral Forest, passed the meadow. We are currently working on its look. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10168702/46561001a84debef6775c2b3ab22d02ff2f01355.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10168702/2ad1aa880f5ce15eea6c358a5815cb9cb79f514f.png[/img]

And finally, we started to work on other things than rocks for the second biome in Nanotale. That little house is the first step to create a troglodyte village. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10168702/bb5babae2243c129fdf6bcb88a567ac07acc08ef.png[/img]

[h1]BONUS[/h1]

[i]These inquisitive little creatures follow you around, no matter where you go. Not even distressed by the attacks of the blue predators on these lands. Though no one ever saw one attack a Green Jasper particularly.[/i]

Visit the link below to have a closer look at the 3D model of the Green Jasper. 

https://skfb.ly/6KVFx 


If you want to see more about the development, follow the game on Steam, [url=https://twitter.com/nanotalegame]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.facebook.com/nanotalegame]Facebook[/url], or [url=http://www.discord.gg/fishingcactus]Discord[/url]. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/944920/Nanotale__Typing_Chronicles/

Thank you for reading. 

Cheers,
VirginRedemption

notes.title: Do you hear what I hear? New update!
notes.notes:
Hi Reindeer Riders,

We wanted to give you something special for Christmas. Of course, for those of you who don't own the game yet, the best present will be the discount during the Winter Sales. But for the others, we chose something that sounds less like buying and more like sharing. 

You’ve probably noticed that our main menu has a kind of Christmas feeling, so has one of our [b]Arenas[/b]. But the major update for this holiday season is the [b]Japanese language fully implemented in the game[/b]. As usual, don’t hesitate to tell us if you find typos or weird translations.

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/l4JyNDMHtA9cxlg6A/source.gif[/img]

Also, IndieDB will announce the [b]Indie of the Year[/b] in 5 days. Epistory has the chance to be part of top 100. [url=http://www.indiedb.com/groups/2016-indie-of-the-year-awards/top100#vote40141][b]Don’t hesitate to vote for us[/b][/url] if you feel like the game should win. We’ll add that there’s no need to be logged to vote. 

[url=http://www.indiedb.com/games/epistory]
[img]http://media.indiedb.com/images/groups/1/26/25073/profile/ioty-250.png[/img][/url]

To finish, every year for Christmas, we run a 48h internal Game Jam and this year we wanted to share the crazy and unfinished projects from previous years with our community. You can find and download the games [url=http://www.fishingcactus.com/cactusjam/]here[/url]. 


Have a wonderful Holiday Season!

notes.title: New update
notes.notes:
We just pushed the new version of the game. No new features, just a bunch of fixes for the most recent bugs.

Fixed:
- "Blue void" save error. Most, if not all, of you who were affected had slightly different symptoms but we believe the root cause was the same for everyone. It is now fixed but unfortunately the saves are not always compatible/retrievable. If you still have problems starting the game, either reset the saves or send us the corrupted save files and we will [i]try[/i] our best to fix them. 
- Crash at launch on Linux.
- (Silent) Errors when deleting the last profile
- Various small details

That's all for today.

notes.title: Version 1.2 is here!
notes.notes:
After weeks of hard work, we present to you the new and shinier version of Epistory. You spoke and we listened. We understand it would have been better for most of you to receive the update in chunks over the weeks but given the amount of changes it was a lot easier for us to handle one big transition to the new version instead of several small incremental versions. We even had to stop planning for a workshop beta.
Without further ado, here’s the changelist:

Added/Improved
[list]
[*]Mod support.
[*]Profiles (multiple saves) support.
[*]Steam Cloud support.
[*]Distinction between gameplay and story language.
[*]Splash screen only when the game launches.
[*]Removed mouse cursor during gameplay.
[*]Improved arena wave randomness.
[*]Single letter words always get typed, even in the middle of another word.
[*]Several small improvements for the map.
[*](slightly) Improved performance, (massively) reduced spikes.
[*]V-Sync option.
[*]Custom mouse cursor.
[/list]
Fixed
[list]
[*]Several sound errors. Please let us know if you still encounter any problems.
[*]Game not loading on Linux when the OS is not set to English locale.
[*]Several small bugs for the map.
[*]Several small errors in the story texts.
[*]Several keyboard specific patterns.
[*]Music/effects volume preference not always respected.
[*]Entering the “Ice Mausoleum” door without triggering the scene change.
[/list]

And of course several small improvements/fixes across the board that would be too long to list. As always, we welcome your feedback and bug reports.

notes.title: New version is out!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

We fixed another slew of bugs:

Fixes:
[list]
[*]Fixed the uncommon save issue after a power outage or system crash.
[*]Fixed the map in the 5th dungeon.
[*]Fixed the infinite level-up bug.
[*]Fixed the stats not being reset along with the game's progress.
[*]Fixed the chest staying locked in some cases in the 6th dungeon
[*]Fixed several misplayed sfx.
[/list]

Other changes:
[list]
[*]Harder arenas. It should not drastically change the points in the leaderboards but will make the later stages harder to avoid becoming an endurance contest.
[*]Torches and statues now become easier each time you fail.
[*]Music will calm down during the death sequence (both in arenas & in game)
[/list]

That's it for now, have a great day/evening/morning/night.

notes.title: New update
notes.notes:
Good news everyone,

We have pushed a new update which fixes several issues with the game and adds some requested improvements.

Since we did some changes in the way we calculate the scores of the arena, we had to reset the leaderboards.

Here's the list.
[list]
[*]Added easier and harder difficulty levels
[*]Added move control with arrow keys
[*]Added JCUKEN (Russian) and QGMLWY dictionaries
[*]Sound FX volume tweak
[*]Highest combo count is not locked at 16 anymore
[*]Fixed chest achievement
[*]Fixed player sometimes getting stuck after a camera travelling
[*]Various bug fix in game
[*]Various bug fix in arena
[*]Added 2 new arenas
[/list]

We still have some known bugs:

- The uncommon save issue after a power outage or system crash will come at a later (not too distant) date, as it needs more testing.
- The arena leaderboard can be a bit finicky if you don't let the menu load all the scores.
- The map in the 5th dungeon is not always displayed correctly.

Have a great week end.

notes.title: Chapter 2 - Update 1 Bug Fix
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

We hope you are enjoying the new chapter of the game. Since the update, we were busy fixing bugs and continuing work on the next chapter. Thanks to everyone pitching in to help us spot some of these.

Here's a (partial) list of what's changed:

Changed: Quit button in pause menu returns to main menu.

Fixed: Sound was played on the wrong device, even when said device was deactivated. Also known as "There's no sound".
Fixed: The ice door leading to the 4th dungeon was allowing access before the end of the animation.
Fixed: inspiration numbers were not always rounded.
Fixed: console (F1 for the curious among you) was spamming error when starting the arena after a normal game.
Fixed: The texts displayed during a combat were not hidden when you lose the battle.

Other: Small performance improvement.

We also have a list of known bugs that didn't make it into this update:

- Mac version not always having a successful install.
- If a crash/power loss occurs during loading time the save will be corrupted.

The rest of it concerns the next chapter so hush... spoilers...

Have a nice day/week end/steam sales and a happy Thanksgiving!

notes.title: Trick or Treat! Halloween Update
notes.notes:
As promised, Epistory - Typing Chronicles is now available on [b]Linux[/b] and [b]Mac[/b]! If you encounter any bugs please give us a heads up and we’ll fix them as soon as possible. 

The challengers amongst you will be pleased to find the [b]new “Arena” mode[/b] in the main menu. It’s a special place where the world will finally recognize the value of your typing skills. We’re still working on the leaderboard that should come soon. It’s also a bit rough around the edges.

Note that [b]Spanish[/b] language has been added to the game. More languages to come during the Early Access. 

[img=http://blog.fishingcactus.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/10/screenshot_halloween_mac_linux3.jpg]

Here's the patch note for the new version: 
 
[b]New Features[/b]
Added: Infinite Battle “Arena” mode, where you’ll soon be able to challenge yourself and get your name at the top of the leaderboard. 
Added: Linux version
Added: Mac version
Added: Spanish version
And plenty of stuff behind the scene for the upcoming Chapter 2...

[b]Various improvements[/b]
Removed magic effect on enemies' last word.
Special characters are displayed when the required magic is locked.
Reworked “Burning Hollow” level design.
Reworked story in “Forgotten Forest“.

[b]Bug fix[/b]
Fixed: typing the word while it moves result in some letters not colored properly.
Fixed: avatar moving using the last letter of a word typed if the typing mode auto switch is triggered.
Fixed: auto typing mode switch was not happening if an untypeable (fire) word was displayed
Fixed: brambles were reorienting upon hit
And a lot more.


[b]Happy Halloween to all![/b]
